subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are show, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2e40683a59e3661cc7f0b9a034e2b3497275523888f429f2a3a05dfcb18e957.png]
solution:
In first and second dice 2, 3 are common in both dice.

First dice is rotated 180⁰ vertically and then 90⁰ horizontally in anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a1a826f9b23b31138c1a8f53b3a58e9d8fe7f9e376878571ccae5d1c80ac53e.png] 

∴ Here, the opposite face of side '4' is side '5'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
